notes: Shopline-platform site (robots.txt confirms 'we use Shopline'; no Claude-specific disallow, generic User-agent:* only blocks admin/cart/checkout/search paths). Accessed via direct HTTP fetch + HTML parsing (Tier 1, no browser needed). Discovered seasonal categories via: (1) sitewide header nav top-level 'HOLIDAY' item -> /c-697-holiday, (2) the collections sitemap (sitemap_collections_1.xml) filtered for holiday/festive/seasonal slugs, (3) a homepage 'SHOP THANKSGIVING' banner linking to /c-1943-harvest, (4) cross-links/breadcrumbs between the Christmas hub page and its child pages. Qty taken from each collection page's own visible 'facets-count' div ("N items"), cross-checked against the page's In-stock + Out-of-stock filter facet counts in the embedded collection JSON (both sources agreed on every row). Excluded as marketing/non-genuine-category after inspecting each page's actual product sample: /c-2193-holiday-sale (Holiday Sale) and /c-2198-holiday-clearance (Holiday Clearance) - explicit sale/clearance pages; /best-selling-holiday - a Best Sellers list; /c-2326-fall (128 items) and /c-2489-fall-winter-2026 (438 items) - product samples showed ordinary furniture/decor (coffee tables, dining chairs, sofas, rugs, wall mirrors) with no seasonal/autumn theme, i.e. generic 'new for the season' merchandising drops, not a genuine autumn/harvest category; /c-2323-black-tie-holiday-living-room, /c-2437-day-time-christmas-living-room, /c-2438-night-time-christmas-living-room, /c-2221-winter-retreat-living-room, /c-2324-autumn-edit-dining-room - each mixes full furniture (sofas, sectionals, rugs, coffee/end tables) with a few holiday accents, i.e. 'shop this styled room/scene' photo-driven curations, not a product-type seasonal category (Rule 0: product type beats room, and these are room-look pages, not room-filtered product categories); /c-2448-valentines-day-shop (355 items, 'Valentine's Day Gifts & Decor') - product sample was overwhelmingly generic gift/decor items (vases, jewelry boxes, silk pillowcases, perfume bottles) with only sporadic heart/rose/pink items, matching a broad Gift-Guide-style curation rather than a genuine narrow Valentine's product category; scale (355, vs 9-100 for the other confirmed holiday pages) also inconsistent with a real dedicated category. Kept rows verified by product-title sampling to be genuinely holiday-themed even where orphaned from nav (Christmas Collection, Holiday Gifts, Festive Textiles, Holiday Pillows all sampled Christmas/winter-holiday products: ornaments, stockings, pre-lit trees, holiday pillows). The top-level 'Holiday' (/c-697-holiday, 261 items) page's own Category filter facet lists Halloween, Harvest, and Christmas as nested taxonomy values, i.e. it is a genuine mixed-holiday umbrella rather than one specific holiday, so it is kept under the site's own name with a MANUAL REVIEW flag per the hard rule on unpinnable generic branches, rather than assigned to a single holiday. No Diwali/Holi/Eid/other South-Asian festival categories exist on this US site (checked nav, sitemap, and search-discovery terms - none present, consistent with the market).
